disease.notes: Study examined both healthy individuals and those with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus, but granularity is study_level. Individual disease status varies by participant.

disease_details.evidence_quote: four families with multiple cases of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM)...healthy family members

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; study is observational multi-omics analysis, not a treatment response trial.

disease_response_pfs.notes: Not applicable; study is observational, not an oncology trial.

disease_response_pfs_month.notes: Not applicable; not a survival study.

fmt_id.notes: Not a fecal microbiota transplantation study; no FMT participants.

fmt_role.notes: Study is observational; no FMT interventions performed.

hla.notes: HLA typing mentioned implicitly in context of genetic risk (low genetic risk for T1DM), but no specific HLA alleles or typing results reported.

smoker.notes: Tobacco smoking status not reported for any participants.

treatment.evidence_quote: T1DM was in all cases...successfully controlled by insulin replacement therapy

treatment.notes: Insulin replacement therapy reported for all individuals with T1DM. No other medications reported for study participants.

biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified across metagenomic, metatranscriptomic, and metaproteomic levels in T1DM samples
